`final class SignalReplayParts`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.internal.signal.replay` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [SignalReplayParts.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/internal/signal/replay/SignalReplayParts.java)

Text of a concatenation whose parts are known values and holes left by local variables.

## Description

The replay deduces each hole from the text that the setter received.

## Learn more

- [How signals work](/use/in-depth/how-signals-work/)
